cover_headline: MS Dhoni Retires From the IPL After 19 Years, Will Mentor CSK in 2027

end.headline: MS Dhoni Retires From the IPL After 19 Years, Will Mentor CSK in 2027
end.line: Chennai Super Kings confirmed the end of Dhoni's playing career hours before the retention deadline. The five-title captain stays on as Team Mentor from IPL 2027.

facts: Chennai Super Kings announced that MS Dhoni has retired from the Indian Premier League as a player, ending a 19-year IPL career
Dhoni led CSK to five IPL titles and two Champions League T20 titles, and finishes as the franchise's most-capped player with 272 appearances and 5,314 runs for the Super Kings
Dhoni, 45, will stay with the franchise as Team Mentor from IPL 2027, and CSK named no successor

quote.speaker: N Srinivasan
quote.text: There is no CSK without MS Dhoni. For nearly two decades, we have walked and grown alongside each other, through triumphs, setbacks and everything in between.
